title: moments reply
description: What the moments model returns for one source (corpuslm.moments): the moments it proposes, each with its insight and the claims it draws on.

moments.description: The proposed moments, in the order they occur.

insight.description: One sentence of at most 25 words saying what the moment shows.

claims.description: Indexes of the claims the moment draws on, at least one.

items.description: A claim index from the list.
